description: Choices and outcome of one `orbit setup` or `orbit uninstall` run.

detected_agents.description: Agents found on the machine, such as `claude` or `codex`.

selected_agents.description: Agents the run configured or removed.

scope.description: Where the run wrote files: the user-global config or the current project.

interactive.description: True when the user answered the agent picker.

graph_first.description: True when setup installed the graph-first guard. Null for uninstall.

index.description: True when setup indexes the current repository at the end. Null for uninstall.

outcome.description: Result of the run. A failed run sends no setup event; the command event reports the failure.
